title: On the Complexity of Best-Arm Identification in Non-Stationary Linear Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2603.10346v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study the fixed-budget best-arm identification (BAI) problem in non-stationary linear bandits. Concretely, given a fixed time budget $T\in \mathbb{N}$, finite arm set $\mathcal{X} \subset \mathbb{R}^d$, and a potentially adversarial sequence of unknown parameters $\lbrace \theta_t\rbrace_{t=1}^{T}$ (hence non-stationary), a learner aims to identify the arm with the largest cumulative reward $x_* = \arg\max_{x \in \mathcal{X}} x^\top\sum_{t=1}^T \theta_t$ with high probability. In this setting, it is well-known that i.i.d. sampling arms from the G-optimal design yields a minimax-optimal error probability of $\exp\left(-\Theta\left(T / H_{G}\right)\right)$, where $H_{G}$ scales proportionally with the dimension $d$. However, this notion of complexity is overly pessimistic, as it is derived from a lower bound in which the arm set consists only of the standard basis vectors, thus masking any potential advantages arising from arm sets

translated_title: 非平稳线性老虎机中最优臂识别问题的复杂度研究
translated_abstract: 我们研究非平稳线性老虎机中的固定预算最优臂识别（BAI）问题。具体而言，给定一个固定的时间预算 $T\in \mathbb{N}$、一个有限的臂集合 $\mathcal{X} \subset \mathbb{R}^d$，以及一个可能具有对抗性的未知参数序列 $\lbrace \theta_t\rbrace_{t=1}^{T}$（因此是非平稳的），学习者旨在以高概率识别出具有最大累积奖励的臂 $x_* = \arg\max_{x \in \mathcal{X}} x^\top\sum_{t=1}^T \theta_t$。在该设定下，众所周知，从G-最优设计中独立同分布地采样各臂可以得到 $\exp\left(-\Theta\left(T / H_{G}\right)\right)$ 的极小极大最优错误概率，其中 $H_{G}$ 与维度 $d$ 成正比。然而，这种复杂度度量过于悲观，因为它源自一个下界，而该下界仅考虑了由标准基向量构成的臂集合，从而掩盖了臂集合本身可能带来的任何潜在优势
tldr: 本文研究了非平稳线性老虎机中固定预算最优臂识别的复杂度，指出基于G-最优设计的经典复杂度度量过于悲观，因为其下界仅建立在标准基向量构成的臂集合上，掩盖了更丰富的臂集合结构可能带来的优势。
en_tdlr: This paper studies the complexity of fixed-budget best-arm identification in non-stationary linear bandits, showing that the classical G-optimal design-based complexity measure is overly pessimistic, as its lower bound relies only on arm sets of standard basis vectors and thus masks potential advantages from richer arm set structures.
